<reason>CON won the mechanism clash. After PRO owned the leftover-hours gap, CON made the easier vote: existing pre-conviction tools already act on probable cause or a clinician, while red-flag orders occupy the weaker zone, skip the person, and still send a supposedly imminent shooter home. PRO’s lethality/triage and reversible-pause framing stayed live and the Rebuttal 2 clip cost CON, but “implies a hearing” never put the motion’s process on the page, and leftover risk plus the notice/send-home tension were not dissolved.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON Rebuttal 1 (B2.1–B2.3): notice that “can trigger the shooting” cannot coexist with sending that person home as triage, so the tool lives only where other emergency powers would not fire.</best_rebuttal>
